tasks.title: Review Payment Gateway Incident Recovery architecture
tasks.description: Review the Incident Recovery path in Gateway Integration, the current runbook, and the historical records INC-184 and INC-221.
acceptance_criteria: Walk the current Incident Recovery path end to end
Review the recorded Payment Gateway incidents that exercised it
Record the questions the existing material does not answer

tasks.title: Shadow Incident Recovery with Alex Chen
tasks.description: Observe Alex Chen working through Incident Recovery and capture the decision points that are not written down.
acceptance_criteria: Attend a guided exercise end to end
Write down each decision point and what drove it

tasks.title: Execute Incident Recovery in staging
tasks.description: Perform Incident Recovery in staging without step-by-step prompting and confirm normal operation is restored.
acceptance_criteria: Complete Incident Recovery unaided in staging
Verify the system returns to normal operation
Note any step the runbook is missing

tasks.title: Update the Payment Gateway Incident Recovery runbook
tasks.description: Fold the gaps found during the exercise back into the runbook so the next person does not rediscover them.
acceptance_criteria: Add the missing steps identified during practice
